description: Redeem a CONFIRMED on-chain charge for prepaid AI usage credits. Provide the transactionHash of a completed transfer you (the user) sent to the Moneda treasury tagged as a usage-credit purchase. The amount is read from the verified on-chain charge — never from input — converted to USD budget with the standard markup, and granted exactly once (idempotent on the hash, so re-calling is safe).

transactionHash.description: Hash of the confirmed on-chain charge to the Moneda treasury (from get_transactions).

name: purchase_usage_credits
